media.alt: Wooden toys and crayons on a bright playroom table

settings.editor: Wooden toys, clever games and real art supplies, chosen by teachers and parents to spark hours of open-ended play.
We choose toys that last for years and work for many ages: solid beech, water-based paints, sturdy card. If a toy can't survive two siblings, we don't sell it.

settings.title: “The rainbow stacker has been a tunnel, a bridge, a cradle and a racetrack. Best toy we own.”

settings.editor: Use WELCOME10 on your first order. Wrapped with a handwritten card, as always.

settings.title: A toy shop with a teacher's eye

settings.editor: We are two former primary school teachers who believe the best toys do less, so children do more.

A block can be a phone, a car or a cake. We look for toys like that: simple, beautiful and endlessly reusable, made from wood, wool, card and water-based colours.

Every toy is safety tested to EN 71, every order is gift-wrapped for free, and our packaging is recycled and recyclable.

settings.description_text: Toys that become whatever they imagine.
FSC beech, organic cotton, water-based paint.
Free gift wrapping and a handwritten card.

settings.title: Need a gift idea? Ask a teacher.
